RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, November 24, 2010/Agrahayana 3, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Road Transport and Highways; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
Interlocutors on J & K
*201. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the three member team of
interlocutors on J & K appointed by the
Centre has recently asked everyone,
including separatists, to come and joint talks
with them;
(b) if so, whether the separatists in the
valley are against holding any discussions
with the interlocutors;
(c) whether the interlocutors have also
expressed that the Kashmir issue cannot
be resolved without involving Pakistan;
(d) if so, the reaction of Government in
this regard; and
(e) the details of recommendations made
by the three member team of interlocutors
to Government and Government's response
thereon?
Providing access to Indian security
agencies to encrypted messages of
Blackberry
†*202. SHRI SATYA VRAT
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the time-
limit for the Blackberry handset
manufacturing Canadian company
'Research in Motion', to provide access to
the Indian security agencies to its messenger
and enterprise services has again been
extended up 31 December, 2010;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
encrypted (code language) messages of
Blackberry cannot be read by the security
agencies while being sent;
(c) the time when the Blackberry was
first asked to provide access to Indian
security agencies to its messenger and
enterprise services and how many times
the time-limit has been extended so far; and
(d) the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

63
Inclusion of NRIs in Census data
*203. SHRI K.N. BALAGOPAL: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) by when the current Census process
will be completed;
(b) whether NRI data will be included
in the Census data;
(c) whether Government has received
any request or proposal to include NRI
data in the Census data;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) what action has been taken on the
request?
Estimated vis-a-vis actual amount of
toll tax from Delhi-Gurgaon
Expressway
†*204. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that more toll-tax
is being collected from Delhi-Gurgaon
Expressway due to more vehicular traffic
compared to the estimates made years ago;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the amount estimated at that time
and present annual average of actual
amount collected?
Share of India in trade of handicraft
items
*205. SHRI A VTAR SINGH
KARIMPURI: Will the Minister of
TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) the place and share of India in the
total trade of handicraft items in the world;
(b) whether the share of India in the
handicraft items in the world is less as
compared to the ratio of handicraft items
produced in the country;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
increase the export of handicraft items?
Rise in labour disputes in Andhra
Pradesh
*206. SHRIMATI T. RATNA BAI:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
labour disputes are on the rise especially in
the scheduled areas in Andhra Pradesh and
other States;
(b) if so, the State-wise details thereof,
during the last five years; and
(c) the steps being taken to provide
speedy justice in labour disputes?
Action against erring NGOs
*207. SHRI ANIL MADHA V DAVE:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of Non-Governmental
Organizations (NGOs) which have received
foreign aid under various heads like
education, health, sanitation etc., during the
last three years;
(b) the details of such NGOs and
amount received by them during the said
period, with the names and countries of
respective donors;
(c) how many of these NGOs have
submitted audited accounts during the said
period; and
(d) what action Government has taken/
proposes to take against the erring
NGOs?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

64
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Completion of Hyderabad-Warangal
NH by NHDP
*208. SHRIMATI GUNDU
SUDHARANI: Will the Minister of
ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) when was the Hyderabad-Warangal
National Highway taken up by National
Highways Development Projects (NHDP);
(b) whether it is a fact that the Highway
was completed only up to Ghatkesar and
the remaining stretch is yet to be completed;
(c) if so, the present status of this
project;
(d) the reasons for delay in completing
the project; and
(e) by when the remaining stretch is
going to be completed?
CGDA recommendation to ban DGDE
*209. SHRI K.E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Comptroller General of Defence Accounts
(CGDA) has asked the Ministry to ban
the Directorate General of Defence Estates
(DGDE), the custodian of all defence lands
in the country, for widespread irregularities
in the department and its failure to manage
huge land bank in possession of the services
and to transfer all defence estates to DRDO
and MoD; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?
Development of protein food by
DRDO
*210. SHRI NAND KUMAR SAI: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Defence Research
Development Organisation (DRDO) has
made a research in production of protein
food for the jawans posted in remote and
isolated parts of the country;
(b) if so, the names of the various food
products developed by DRDO during the
years 2008-09 and 2009-10;
(c) the details of various food
production units of DRDO existing in
various parts of the country as on date;
(d) the names of the other products
likely to be developed by DRDO for
defence personnel in the near future; and
(e) the details of funds allocated for such
research wok in DRDO during the said
period?
High rise building in Naval area in
Mumbai
†*211. SHRIMA TI KUSUM RAI: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
in Mumbai's Colaba, a 31 storey
skyscrapper has been constructed in the
Naval area violating the defence rules;
(b) if so, the details thereof and whether
the permission of the Ministry was taken
for this purpose; and
(c) if not, the action taken/will be taken
by the Ministry in this regard?
Changes in Contract Labour Law
†*212. SHRI JAI PRAKASH: Will the
Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
make changes in Contract Labour Law for
legal rights of contract labourers;

65
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, whether Government has
considered the demand of industrial sector
for making the labour laws flexible; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Investigation into accident of
Gyaneswari Express
*213. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether CBI is investigating into the
incident of Gyaneswari Express train accident;
(b) if so, how many arrests have so far
been made by CBI;
(c) whether these persons are known
People's Committee against Police
Atrocities (PCPA) activists; and
(d) whether CBI has declared a reward
for providing information about prime
accused?
Death of weavers due to poverty
*214. SHRI RAJIV PRATAP RUDY:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there have been cases of
weaver deaths due to poverty in the States
of Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and West Bengal;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
ensure a dignified life for the artisans
involved in textile weaving?
Need to investigate death of Captain
Kohli
†*215. SHRI A VINASH RAI
KHANNA: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Captain
Kohli, a resident of Chandigarh, died in
Jammu and Kashmir while performing his
duty;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
family members of Captain Kohli have been
expressing doubts over his death;
(c) if so, whether Government will
remove doubts of the family by getting the
issue investigated by some independent
agency, i.e. CBI or any other agency; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Changes in labour Laws
*216. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has made
changes in the labour Laws to make them
simpler;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) how it will be beneficial to the
labourers?
Competition from Chinese imported
tyres
*217. SHRI TARIQ ANW AR: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that local tyre
manufacturers are facing stiff competition
from imported Chinese tyres;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps Government is taking to
help the local tyre manufacturers?
Scheme for modernization of UP
Police
†*218. SHRI NARESH CHANDRA
AGRAW AL: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of

66
Uttar Pradesh has submitted any scheme
to Central Government for modernization
of its police force;
(b) if so, whether Central Government
has given approval thereto; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Atrocities on Dalits in Chitradurga
district
*219. SHRI V . HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 25 Dalit
families of Budihalli village in Chitradurga
district of Karnataka left the village in
August, 2010 due to atrocities by landlords;
(b) if so, whether caste discrimination and
bondage is still prevalent in our society; and
(c) if so, the action taken so far by
Government against the culprits?
Share of women in wage employment
in non-farm sector
*220. SHRIMATI KANIMOZHI : Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the current share of women in wage
employment in the non-farm sector, State-
wise;
(b) whether Government has analysed
the reasons for the low percentage of
women in wage employment in the non-
farm sector, if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has
constituted any committee to study how
workplaces can be made women friendly;
and
(d) whether there is a discrimination in
wage payments against women, if so, the
details thereof?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 18th November, 2010 Secretary-General.
Kartika 27, 1932 (Saka)
